job.title: Senior Python SDET
job.description:
Lumenfield Labs (fictional) is hiring a Senior Python SDET for internal developer tools.

Required:
- 5+ years of software testing or backend engineering
- Python, pytest, and API testing against REST services
- FastAPI or similar Python web frameworks
- GitHub Actions CI/CD and Docker
- Comfortable reading production Python, not only writing tests

Nice to have:
- Playwright
- AWS (App Runner, ECS/Fargate, or Lambda)
- SQL

candidate.headline: Senior test engineer, Python automation
candidate.summary: Sample profile. Six years writing pytest suites for Python APIs, plus Docker and GitHub Actions. Recent work includes FastAPI contract tests and a small AWS deploy checklist. Not a real person.
